cases.reason: Constrained emphasis is incorrectly recognized inside a word.
Escaped formatting markers are still parsed as formatting.
Unconstrained double markers create empty strong nodes.
Macros introduced by attribute substitution are not recognized.
The subs attribute is stored but not applied.
A blank line incorrectly splits a list into two lists.
